responsibility: Implements the default-channel wrapper for LONGINT and LONGCARD text I/O by delegating to LongWholeIO with StdChans.StdInChan and StdChans.StdOutChan. It contains no parsing or formatting logic of its own and serves only as the standard-stream convenience layer over the channel-based long whole-number subsystem.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file implements SLongWholeIO by forwarding long whole-number reads and writes to LongWholeIO with StdChans.StdInChan and StdChans.StdOutChan. It differs from SLongWholeIO.def, which only specifies the exported default-channel integer I/O procedures.
